declarations.description:
Execute a shell command inside the repository sandbox.

        You can run any shell command (Python scripts, tests, git commands, etc.).
        The command runs in the repository workspace. No network access.

        Args:
            command: Shell command to execute (e.g., "pytest tests/", "python3 script.py").
declarations.name: run_command

declarations.description:
Read the contents of a file from the repository workspace.

        Supports reading specific line ranges using start_line and end_line (1-indexed).
        To avoid overwhelming the context window, large files are automatically truncated
        to a maximum number of lines (default: 150 lines).

        Args:
            filepath: Relative path within the workspace directory (e.g., "fastapi/main.py", "pyproject.toml").
            start_line: Optional starting line number (1-indexed, inclusive).
            end_line: Optional ending line number (1-indexed, inclusive).

        Returns:
            Dictionary containing file content, line range, and truncation status.
declarations.name: read_file

declarations.description:
Replace a contiguous block of text in an existing file.

        More token-efficient than write_file for targeted changes. Provide 2-4 lines of unique
        surrounding context in old_string to ensure an unambiguous match.

        Args:
            filepath: Relative path to the target file.
            old_string: Text block to replace.
            new_string: Replacement text block.
            allow_multiple: Replace all occurrences of old_string if True.

        Returns:
            Dictionary containing file status, occurrences count, match strategy, and unified diff.
declarations.name: edit_file

declarations.description:
Create or overwrite a file in the workspace.

        Args:
            filepath: Relative path to the file to create or overwrite.
            content: Full content of the file.
declarations.name: write_file

declarations.description: Check active budget details (time, tool calls) and active patch details.
declarations.name: get_status

declarations.description:
Capture the current working tree modifications as the agent's submission.

        This generates a unified git diff against the baseline commit. The agent
        can submit multiple times; only the final submission is evaluated.
declarations.name: submit_patch

declarations.description:
Discover structural code graph neighbors (callers and callees) for a given code node.

        Args:
            node: Dotted symbol path or suffix of the function, method, or class node (e.g. 'pkg.module.Class.method', 'Class.method', or 'parse_request').
            edge_type: Optional edge relation filter (e.g. 'calls', case-insensitive).
            max_neighbors: Maximum number of neighbor nodes to return (default: 50).

        Returns:
            Dictionary with list of neighbor node names and count.
declarations.name: get_code_neighbors

declarations.description:
Find semantically similar code functions and classes using precomputed graph embeddings.

        Args:
            query: Dotted symbol path or suffix of a function/method/class in the repository (e.g. 'pkg.module.Class.method', 'Class.method', or 'func_name') to find similar code for. Falls back to lexical keyword matching if no symbol matches.
            k: Number of most similar code nodes to return (default: 10).

        Returns:
            Dictionary containing matching node names, code snippets, and similarity scores.
declarations.name: search_similar_code

declarations.description:
Extract the relationship graph (nodes and connecting edges) for a focal set of code elements.

        Args:
            nodes: List of dotted symbol paths or suffix names (e.g. ['pkg.mod.Class.method', 'helper_fn']) to include in the induced subgraph.

        Returns:
            Dictionary detailing the subgraph nodes and connecting directed edges.
declarations.name: get_code_subgraph
